entities.summary: Kenrich Lo Williams, nicknamed "Kenny Hustle", is an American professional basketball player for the Oklahoma City Thunder of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the TCU Horned Frogs of the Big 12 Conference. After going undrafted, Williams signed with the New Orleans Pelicans in 2018, spending two seasons with the team before being traded to the Thunder in 2020, later winning an NBA championship in 2025.
